These files are generated by `npm run vendor` (see tools/vendor/build.mjs). Each package keeps its own license.

| Package | Version | License | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| pyodide | 314.0.7 | MPL-2.0 | Python in the browser |
| @yowasp/clang | 22.0.0-git20542-10 | ISC | C++ compiler in the browser (LLVM, Clang, LLD, libc++) |
| @bjorn3/browser_wasi_shim | 0.4.2 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | runs compiled C++ programs |
| @codemirror/state | 6.7.6 | MIT | code editor |
| @codemirror/view | 6.43.15 | MIT | code editor |
| @codemirror/commands | 6.11.1 | MIT | code editor |
| @codemirror/language | 6.13.1 | MIT | code editor |

| @codemirror/lang-cpp | 6.0.3 | MIT | code editor |

| @lezer/highlight | 1.2.5 | MIT | code editor |

## Not bundled

CheerpJ 5 (Java in the browser) is not part of these files. The Java sandbox (the java/ folder, a separate Worker) loads it at run
time from https://cjrtnc.leaningtech.com. It is used under CheerpJ's free Community license for individuals and non-commercial
open source, which asks for the credit "Built with CheerpJ". The site does not show the credit in its sidebar; it is kept here, in the README and on the sandbox page. See https://cheerpj.com/licensing/.
